blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—The Lapu-Lapu City Traffic Management System (CTMS) announced the closure of selected roads during the annual fiesta celebration on Nov. 20-21, 2026. Authorities will implement the temporary road closure on roads leading to and surrounding the Virgen de la Regla Parish Church to facilitate the smooth flow of traffic. The road closure will start from 4:00 a.m. to 12:00 midnight on those days.
